description: Record a dataset, API, MCP tool or service you (or your principal) need and the most you would pay for it. Free; no payment is taken. Do not include personal data.

agent_model.description: Optional, the model you run on.

category.description: Closest category; use 'other' if none fit.

current_alternative.description: What you use today instead, if anything.

current_alternative_cost.description: What that alternative costs you, if known.

description.description: What exactly you need, at what granularity and coverage. Do NOT include personal data about anyone.

desired_format.description: e.g. JSON, Parquet, CSV, MCP tool returning structured JSON.

expected_monthly_units.description: How many units per month you expect to buy.

kind.description: What sort of thing you want.

max_price.description: The most you would pay per unit, as a number.

payment_rails.description: Payment methods you can use autonomously.

principal_type.description: Who you act for. Do not name them.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region the demand relates to.

title.description: Short name for what you want, e.g. 'Daily UK electricity half-hourly prices API'.

use_case.description: What task this would let you (or your principal) complete.

name: register_demand
title: Register demand
